---
title: "sbcggplotschools"
output: html_document
date: "2025-04-16"
---

Load packages: 
```{r}
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(leaflet)
library(mapview)
library(raster)
library(lubridate)
library(tidycensus)
```

load data: 

```{r}
schools <- sbcschooldistrictfunding

supervisorial_sf <- read_sf("data/Supervisorial_Boundaries.geojson")
```

make column with popdensity

```{r}
supervisorial_sf <- transform(supervisorial_sf, popdensity = POPULATION / AREA)
```

break down Reap, Title I, and None 

```{r}
REAP <- schools %>% filter(primaryfedfunding == "REAP")

TitleI <- schools %>% filter(primaryfedfunding == "Title I")

None <- schools %>%  filter(primaryfedfunding == "None")
```

attempt to map: 

```{r}
ggplot(data = supervisorial_sf) + geom_sf(aes(fill = popdensity), alpha = 1) +
  geom_point(data = REAP, mapping = aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude), colour = "red")

```
